title: arrhenatherum elatius f. biflorum
intro: Arrhenatherum elatius f. biflorum, commonly known as meadow oatgrass, is a flowering plant that belongs to the grass family Poaceae. This plant is valued for its therapeutic properties and has been used in traditional medicine to promote relaxation, reduce anxiety, and improve sleep quality. The health benefits of Arrhenatherum elatius f. biflorum include its potential to lower blood pressure, reduce inflammation, and act as an antioxidant. The bioactive constituents of this plant include flavonoids, phenolic acids, and saponins, which contribute to its therapeutic actions.
